city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacujem Connectorovu početnu vrednost za parking: prikazano poređenje sada ide od 136 do 356, a bez vremena merenja ne može da utvrdi kada su mesta postala slobodna. Takođe ne mogu da pretvorim podudarne izjave o pobedi u Danasu i Beti u nezavisnu potvrdu lokalnog događaja; nijedan sažetak ne utvrđuje njegovo mesto ili vreme. [F5][F7][F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I reject Connector's parking baseline: the displayed comparison now runs from 136 to 356, and absent measurement times it cannot establish when spaces became available [F5]. I also cannot turn the matching victory language in Danas and Beta into independent confirmation of a local event; neither summary establishes its location or time [F7][F9].
